Trust & Will review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026 · Independent: sponsors can't buy a verdict · How we rate

Verdict: Popular online tool for US wills and trusts with guided questions. Not built for Australian or most non-US jurisdictions. Best for: US residents who want a straightforward will or trust online.

Good

Best for

US residents who want a straightforward will or trust online.

Skip if

you live outside the US

Pros

  • Guided, plain-English interview for wills and trusts
  • State-specific US documents
  • Attorney-led plans for complex situations, plus an optional membership for updates

Cons

  • US-focused; not suitable for most other countries
  • Not a replacement for a lawyer in complex estates
